start.title: [TODO:ar] Three Graves in Moab
start.text:
[TODO:ar] Naomi has lost her husband and sons.
Grief settles like dusk.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Sit in silence beside her grief
[TODO:ar] Leave her to mourn alone
[TODO:ar] Tell her to forget the dead

alone_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Return to Her
alone_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] She is your mother by love.
Go back and sit with her.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Sit in silence beside her grief
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] She leans her head to yours.

forget_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Honor Her Loss
forget_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Grief is not a stain to wipe.
Let her weep beside you.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Sit in silence beside her grief
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You bow your head with hers.

road_decision.title: [TODO:ar] She Tells You to Go Home
road_decision.text:
[TODO:ar] "Return to your people," she pleads.
The road forks before you.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Turn back to Moab and your gods
[TODO:ar] Wait for another to decide for you
[TODO:ar] "Where you go, I will go."

turnback_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Loyalty Calls You
turnback_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Comfort lies behind, but love walks ahead.
Go with Naomi.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] "Where you go, I will go."

wait_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Choose for Yourself
wait_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] No one can carry your vow but you.
Speak it now.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] "Where you go, I will go."
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The words rise from your heart.

bethlehem_arrival.title: [TODO:ar] Bethlehem at Dawn
bethlehem_arrival.text:
[TODO:ar] Naomi returns home empty-handed.
The village whispers around you.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Hide your Moabite roots in shame
[TODO:ar] Beg in the street for bread
[TODO:ar] Offer to glean grain to feed her

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Walk Without Shame
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Your love for Naomi is not a stain.
Lift your head and serve.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Offer to glean grain to feed her

beg_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Take Up the Sickle
beg_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Your hands can gather what falls.
The fields are open to the poor.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Offer to glean grain to feed her

barley_field.title: [TODO:ar] Among the Reapers
barley_field.text:
[TODO:ar] Boaz, kind and strong, sees you working.
"Stay in my fields," he says.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Refuse his kindness in pride
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Grace is meant to be received.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Bow and thank him with humility
[TODO:ar] Demand more than he offers

refuse_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Receive His Kindness
refuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Pride leaves you with empty hands.
Accept the gift before you.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Bow and thank him with humility

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] A Quiet Heart
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] His mercy is not yours to seize.
Receive it gently.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Bow and thank him with humility

threshing_floor.title: [TODO:ar] Naomi's Counsel
threshing_floor.text:
[TODO:ar] "Go to the threshing floor," she says.
"Ask Boaz to be your redeemer."

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Trust Naomi and go in faith
[TODO:ar] Ignore her wisdom and stay home
[TODO:ar] Seek a wealthier man instead
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Boaz is the kinsman God gave.

ignore_consequence.text:

Follow it through the dark.

redemption_home.text:
